title: Equivariant basic cohomology of Lie groupoids
summary: This paper develops equivariant basic cohomology for Lie groupoids equipped with weak actions of Lie groups. The weak action is encoded by a Kan fibration over the classifying groupoid, and the basic complex of the fiber is shown to carry the structure needed for Weil and Cartan models. The construction is compared with Bott--Shulman--Stasheff cohomology, where the equivariant theory is obtained from the quotient groupoid.
